one_month_reasoning: Two scheduled events fall in the window: September monthly revenue (Oct 8) and 3Q26 results plus 4Q guidance (Oct 15; quiet period Oct 5-14). July+August revenue was NT$982.4B, so September needs only NT$483.2B (-6% m/m) to hit the TOP of 3Q guidance; a flat September implies ~US$46.8B vs the $44.6-45.8B guide (src 4). Combined with the 2027 price hikes reported Sep 24 (src 5) and a likely full-year growth raise above 'slightly above 40%', I expect a beat-and-raise. But TSMC beats are habitual and expected (2Q beat was large, yet the stock fell ~8% the following weeks, src 2/12 and the July price path), the stock has run from ~$411 (Sep 3) to $459 into the print, and macro (10y near 5%, oil >$100) drove the September chop. So only a small positive tilt (~+0.8% drift) and vol bumped ~10% above annual/3.5 for the earnings event; distribution roughly lognormal with sigma ~12.6% for the month.

fair_value.method: Blend of 19.5x forward P/E on my FY2028E EPS of $25.5/ADR (~$497, 60%) and a 2.6% FCF yield on FY2027E FCF of ~$12.9/ADR (~$495, 40%), giving ~$496 as the price a buyer should pay in Oct 2027.

methods.name: P/E
methods.inputs: FY2028E EPS $25.5/ADR x 19.5x forward multiple (market in Oct-2027 prices FY2028). Bridge: FY26E $17.3 -> FY27E $21.8 -> FY28E $25.5.

inputs_detail.derivation: 1Q $3.49 + 2Q $4.31 + 3Q ~$4.69 (revenue ~$46.8B if Sept ~= Aug per src 4, net margin ~52% given 2nm dilution, 5.186B ADR-equivalents from NT$706.56B / NT$27.25 x 1/5) + 4Q ~$4.8. Above Zacks/MarketBeat ($15.35-16.56) because consensus lagged the 2Q beat.

Consensus $21.22 (src 8) nudged up ~3%: revenue +25% (3-6% wafer price hikes with AI orders paying more, src 5; hyperscaler capex +~50% to ~$1.1-1.3T, src 9), net margin slipping ~1pt on N2 and overseas-fab dilution (src 16).

+17%: Investment Case base case has revenue compounding ~20% through 2030 with gross margin fading from ~65% to ~61.5% (src 16); capacity remains the binding constraint (src 13), supporting continued double-digit growth.

Today: $459.2 / $21.22 consensus FY27 = 21.6x next-year EPS; July Zacks fwd P/E 29.4x on FY26 (src 7). Community narrative uses 18-19x as a Taiwan-risk-adjusted multiple (src 14). I use 19.5x for Oct-2027 because growth decelerates from ~45% to ~17% and the price-hike/scarcity narrative is more mature.

methods.name: FCF yield
methods.inputs: FY2027E revenue ~$214B x OCF margin ~68% = ~$145B, less capex ~$78B = FCF ~$67B = ~$12.9/ADR, capitalised at 2.6% FCF yield.

inputs_detail.derivation: Price +3-6% (src 5), wafer volume +~13% plus packaging growth (src 16), hyperscaler capex +~50% (src 9) gives a 25% midpoint with capacity as the constraint.
~25% above 2026's $62B midpoint; under-investment criticism (src 13) and new N3/N2 fabs plus Arizona expansion push capex intensity up to ~36% of revenue.
2Q26 net margin 55.6% (src 2); net margin ~53% in 2027 plus D&A ~15% of revenue gives ~68%.
Consistent with ~20x earnings and a ~38% capex intensity; today's implied yield on FY27 FCF at $459 is ~2.8%, I assume a slight re-rating up as capex intensity peaks.

bear.story: AI capex digestion in 2027 (hyperscaler FCF negative except Microsoft, src 9), CoWoS/N3 tightness flips to normal, margins fall to low 60s on N2 and overseas dilution, multiple compresses to ~15x on ~$20 EPS; includes a ~5% tail of a Taiwan blockade/crisis scare (Polymarket 11-13% invasion odds by mid/end-2027, which I treat as overstated for a full invasion but indicative of coercion risk) with prices ~$150-250.

base.story: Beat-and-raise cycle continues: 3Q26 beats top of guide, FY27 revenue +25% with 3-6% price hikes, EPS ~$22 in FY27 and ~$25.5 run-rate into FY28, multiple eases to ~19.5x.

bull.story: Scarcity pricing widens (AI orders paying well above the 3-6% floor), N2 booked to 2028 at ~$30k/wafer, margins hold high-60s, FY28 EPS ~$28 at 23-24x.

thesis_break_reason: $320 (-30%) would value TSMC at ~15x consensus FY27 EPS, i.e. pricing no growth beyond 2026. Getting there would most likely mean either hyperscalers cutting 2027 AI capex (orders/price hikes reversing, monthly revenue turning down y/y-sequentially) or a material escalation in the Taiwan Strait, not ordinary 40%-vol noise; it is also below the post-2Q pullback low (~$373) and the September range.

Macro: 10y yield near 5% compressing high-multiple tech
reasoning: Starting point: $459.2, 40% realized vol. Fundamentals are very strong: 2Q26 EPS $4.31/ADR (+77% y/y), 3Q tracking ~$1B above top of guide on July-August revenue, 2027 wafer price hikes of 3-6% with visibility to 2030, capex raised to $60-64B, and hyperscaler capex expected +~50% in 2027. Alternative-lane sources (SemiWiki forum, Stratechery, Substacks, Dan Nystedt on X) are uniformly bullish on scarcity and pricing power, which tells me the good news is well known rather than unpriced; the forum's flag of mature-node weakness and the Substack consensus that the bull-bear spread is mostly Taiwan risk are the main counterpoints. Alt-data: Arizona job openings (~134-183, Sep 2026) are consistent with ongoing overseas ramp and the margin dilution that comes with it, not a demand signal. Prediction markets: Polymarket 13% invasion by 2027-12-31 ($3.3M volume) and ~11% by 2027-06-30, down from ~30% in late 2025; I treat a full invasion inside the horizon as ~3-5% but keep a 5% crisis component in the distribution. Valuation: my FY26E EPS $17.3 and FY27E $21.8 (consensus $21.22) and FY28E $25.5 at 19.5x give ~$497; FCF yield cross-check ~$495; blended fair value ~$496, ~8% above spot. Distribution: 95% lognormal with median $485 and sigma 0.34 (a bit under realized vol because earnings visibility is high) plus 5% crisis lognormal at median $220; this gives P(>=459) ~54%, mean ~ $505, and a fat left tail (P(<321) ~15%). Research note: X posts could not be fetched (HTTP 402) so the Nystedt post is cited from its search snippet and verified against the 6-K; Twelve Data estimate endpoints were unavailable on the plan, so consensus comes from Zacks/MarketBeat pages. No option data was consulted.
